title: glosa kg edge
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §8.1: one edge per typed relation between two kg nodes, append-only (a correction is a NEW line with status RETRACTED on the old edge, never an in-place edit). `derives_from` vs `borrows` is deliberate and non-collapsible (forced/borrowed/Open ledger): derives_from = a shown, checkable derivation step; borrows = an imported anchor taken on trust, not re-derived. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.
